purpose: gnssl11a (kernel q10jr11 / 0364): S11 (K=30, ioctl 170): ONE boot, the whole libmnl DSP code download in the kernel: steps 1..17 (wake vote held, INTEN off), MCUB RESET_DONE ack, EMI_REQ_GPS, then continuous (one 2 s pause before): header 0xFE08 -> ack 0xFE31 seq 0 (COMD4 x3 + header, 3 rounds), 50 fragments 0xFE0C each with RX DMA2 armed first (64 B) -> ack 0xFE32 seq k (2 resends), post-boot command 0xFE05 + 3 s capture (RX 256 B per arming, hex dump, frames parsed), full rollback. Frames uploaded by the tool (embedded n2gpsdl_bootdata.h) with N2GD_IOC_CHUNK and validated by the kernel first. Tool gpu/hwcodec/gnss/probe/n2gpsdl_replay.c installed under the n2gpsdl_step name. Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
